purpose: Read-only comparison between independent lens outputs before any real fusion policy; adds deterministic conflict_summary (no LLM). v0.4.0 adds optional market_myeongni_lens_v1 as 5th input (with optional market_sasang_lens_v1 as 4th).
market_sasang_wiring_v0_3: Runner loads market_sasang_lens_v1 when file exists and --no-market-sasang is not set. Maps fusion_bridge.score_hint→direction_score; confidence from 1−composite_uncertainty, ×0.25 on veto.force_hold. Extra fields under inputs[].market_sasang_lens_v1 for coordinator.
market_myeongni_wiring_v0_4: Runner loads market_myeongni_lens_v1 when file exists and --no-market-myeongni is not set. Uses overlay scores from market_myeongni_lens_v1; upstream myeongni engine unchanged. Extra fields under inputs[].market_myeongni_lens_v1 for coordinator. Daily chain opt-in: run_btrack_daily_hypothesis_chain.ps1 -IncludeMarketMyeongniOverlay.

payload_conflict_summary_v0_2.conflict_narrative_guarded: Single string: majority/minority lens ids, per-lens scores, optional Logos verse_id list + clipped narrative_snippet_guarded from logos artifact.
payload_conflict_summary_v0_2.minority_lens_ids: Lens ids whose direction_sign differs from consensus majority_sign.
payload_conflict_summary_v0_2.logos_evidence_verse_ids: From logos artifact evidence_refs[].verse_id when present.
